hero_kpi_rationale: Assets under management (AUM) are the primary revenue driver for Franklin Templeton. Their trajectory reflects the company's ability to attract and retain investor capital.
company_description: Franklin Resources, Inc. is a publicly owned asset investment manager. Through its subsidiaries, the firm provides its services to individuals, institutions, pension plans, trusts, and partnerships. It launches equity, fixed income, balanced, and multi-asset mutual funds through its subsidiaries. The firm invests in the public equity, fixed income, and alternative markets. Franklin Resources, Inc. was founded in 1947 and is based in San Mateo, California with an additional office in Calgary, Alberta; Dubai, United Arab Emirates; Edinburgh, Midlothian; Fort Lauderdale, Florida; Hyderabad, India; London, Greater London; Rancho Cordova, California; Shanghai, Shanghai Province; Singapore; Stamford, Connecticut; and Vienna.

kpis.name: Assets Under Management
kpis.explanation: Total amount of assets managed by the company on behalf of its clients.
kpis.description: Assets under management are the core business of Franklin Templeton, directly determining its revenues.
kpis.signal: Slight decline in assets under management despite supportive markets.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit relative to total revenues.
kpis.description: Operating margin measures the efficiency of operating cost management.

kpis.name: Operating Revenues
kpis.explanation: Total revenues generated by the company's core activities.
kpis.description: Operating revenues represent the company's gross revenue before deducting costs.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Final profit after all expenses and taxes.
kpis.description: Net income represents the company's overall profitability.

kpis.name: Average Assets Under Management
kpis.explanation: Average of assets under management over a given period.
kpis.description: Average assets under management are a more stable performance indicator than period-end assets under management.
kpis.signal: Increase in average assets under management, a positive sign for future revenues.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $0.33 last year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 fiscal years reported.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $0.684 billion last year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends Paid / Net Income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Share of net income distributed as dividends: 130.3% last year.

kpis.name: AI-Integrated Offerings Share
kpis.explanation: Percentage of new offerings or products integrating artificial intelligence features.
kpis.description: Measures AI integration in the company's products and services.

kpis.name: AI API Call Volume
kpis.explanation: Number of calls made to AI-related application programming interfaces.
kpis.description: Early indicator of customer usage and adoption of AI capabilities.

kpis.name: Earnings Per Share
kpis.explanation: Net income divided by the average number of diluted shares over the fiscal year. Used to visualize the company's ability to generate earnings per share: the basis for calculating Payout Ratio (DPS / EPS).
kpis.description: 5-year history (2021-2025). Source: yfinance income statement (Diluted EPS).
